annotations.title: Identify a team from its bracket name (Tournament Scout)

description: Turn a team name as a tournament lists it (for example "City SC BU14 EA" or "Vaqueros BU14 Premier") into the real league team, with a confidence label, the evidence, and the other candidates when more than one fits. Searches every Pitch Network region. Pass age and gender when the name does not include them.

region.description: Where the tournament is, used only to break ties.
